name: Standing Up For Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively defend and support those who are vulnerable, such as the poor, fatherless, and widows, urging us to seek justice and relief for the oppressed (Psalms 82:3; Isaiah 1:17). We are commanded to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves and to stand firm against wickedness rather than falling before it (Proverbs 31:8; Proverbs 25:26). The Bible highlights the importance of mutual support among believers, warning against isolation in times of hardship and encouraging us to lift one another up (Ecclesiastes 4:10). Ultimately, this call to stand up for others is grounded in the love God demonstrated by giving His Son for the salvation of all (John 3:16).
